label: Opening Hook
text: In July 1518, a woman began dancing in a Strasbourg street and could not stop, and within weeks dozens more joined her.
title: File:The dancing mania Wellcome M0014846.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Began with a woman known as Frau Troffea in July 1518 Records describe dozens and perhaps up to 400 dancers over several weeks Reports that people danced to death are uncertain; contemporary sources are limited Authorities first encouraged the dancing, even hiring musicians Explanations include mass psychogenic illness amid famine and disease; ergot poisoning is a disputed theory
